currentCard.prompt: Какая компания выпустила аркадную Space Invaders в 1978 году?

answers.note: Atari основали Нолан Бушнелл и Тед Дэбни в 1972 году.
Соник стал «лицом» Sega и дебютировал в игре 1991 года.
В 1990 году SNK представила аркадную MVS и домашнюю Neo Geo.
В публикации The Strong 2021 года Space Invaders названа самым популярным тайтлом Taito.

currentCard.explanation: Space Invaders — аркадная игра Taito, выпущенная в Японии в 1978 году. Её успех вызвал сначала в Японии, а затем и по всему миру бум аркадных игр.

literal.prompt: Какая компания выпустила аркадную Space Invaders в 1978 году?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The Strong L202 identifies Taito’s arcade game as released in Japan in1978; slot3 Taito is uniquely correct. The explicit arcade and1978 qualifiers exclude the later Atari2600 home version described at L206 (1980); Atari is therefore a plausible but incorrect port/platform confusion, not a second key. Sega and SNK are real gaming/arcade companies (their official histories show amusement/game hardware activity), so all four options are company names of the same category. The feminine company construction выпустила is consistent for every standalone label; no answer-form clue.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Atari L358 gives the full names Nolan Bushnell and Ted Dabney; L364-L365 explicitly says the cofounders founded Atari in1972. sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: SEGA L27 describes creating a character as Sega’s 顔 (face); L29 identifies Sonic; L31 dates his first named game to June23 1991; L38-L40 describes becoming the Sega image character/face. The note accurately combines the own-company mascot relation and1991 game debut, without a false region/date or hardware claim. Useful Sega history; overlap with peer5 MAIN is permissible in a wrong-option note.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: В 1990 году SNK представила аркадную MVS и домашнюю Neo Geo.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: SNK L99-L111 places the MVS/NEO GEO release in1990 and explicitly distinguishes the Multi Video System arcade board from home NEO GEO. L99 says April and L105 says March; the note prudently asserts only the common1990 year, not a disputed month. Представила does not overclaim retail availability or identical business arrangements. Useful own-company hardware history.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: В публикации The Strong 2021 года Space Invaders названа самым популярным тайтлом Taito.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The Strong L206 explicitly calls Space Invaders Taito’s most popular title, and L219 dates the publication August20 2021. The note preserves both attribution and historical publication year, rather than asserting an unqualified current measurable ranking. This adds the title’s standing within Taito’s catalogue, beyond the asked1978 publisher relation; it is a concrete useful own-Taito fact, not just repeating Taito released the game.

absoluteLevel.ground: Space Invaders is a widely recognized game, but distinguishing its original Japanese arcade publisher Taito from Atari’s later home-console association and the Japanese Sega/SNK brands requires thematic familiarity. Retro-game players can reasonably know it; adults outside games cannot derive it from absurd alternatives. No niche circuit/date detail beyond the canonical release period is required, so MEDIUM rather than broad-adult EASY or specialist HARD.
